dct_description_sm: The purpose of the development of this data set was to address the objective of a master's thesis proposal examining the extent of dietary overlap between co-occurring forage fishes in the Beaufort Sea, namely Capelin and Arctic Cod. These data will be used to calculate Schoener's diet overlap index and determine if shifts in diet occur within each species among different size classes with respect to composition, biomass and energy of taxa consumed.
dct_title_s: Beaufort Regional Environmental Assessment (BREA) Marine Fishes Project - Stomach Content Data of Capelin (Mallotus villosus) and Arctic Cod (Boreogadus saida) in the Beaufort Sea, summer 2013
